stories.meaning: SGLN tracks gold in pounds, so it moves with gold and with the pound-dollar rate. A hawkish Fed tonight would be the main risk for it.

sources.title: Gold - Price - Chart - Historical Data - News

stories.summary: Gold fell below $4,050 an ounce on Wednesday after two days of gains, Trading Economics reports, trading around $4,030. Traders expect the Fed to hold rates tonight but are watching for hints of a December hike; higher-rate expectations have weighed on gold this year.

explainer.meaning: The main global benchmark price for oil, based on North Sea crude.

stories.headline: Oil jumps 1.4% after Houthis say they hit Saudi Arabia's biggest refinery
stories.meaning: High oil keeps inflation worries alive, which is what has pushed up interest-rate expectations this autumn. That matters for growth stocks and gold in your portfolio.

sources.title: Oil prices rise after attack on Saudi Arabian refinery reignites supply concerns

stories.summary: Yemen's Houthis said they struck Saudi Arabia's largest oil refinery, a 550,000 barrel-a-day plant, with a missile; Saudi authorities had not confirmed it. Reuters reported Brent up 1.4% at $115.47 and US crude at $101.33 early Wednesday, after falling nearly $2 on Tuesday. ING said oil stays elevated as markets wait on Trump's next move on Iran.

explainer.meaning: The Federal Open Market Committee, the Fed group that votes on US interest rates eight times a year.

stories.headline: Fed decision tonight at 6pm UK: a hold at 3.75-4.00% is expected, with Warsh's hike talk in focus
stories.meaning: A hold is the base case. What moves markets is the tone: hints of a December hike would tend to hurt tech shares and gold, both big parts of your portfolio.

sources.title: Futures Trade Mixed Ahead of Big Tech Earnings and the Fed's Rate Decision

stories.summary: The Fed ends its two-day meeting today and is expected to leave rates at 3.75-4.00%, TipRanks reports; markets will watch Chair Kevin Warsh for hints of further hikes. US futures were mixed overnight as Alphabet and Microsoft also report after the close.

explainer.meaning: How much room the government has against its own borrowing rules before it would break them.

stories.headline: Budget day: Healey speaks at 12:30, with fiscal headroom and gilt yields the market's focus; pound near $1.33

impacts.why: Admirals: headroom below £10bn could push GBP/USD back towards 1.32-1.31; a 'dull and disciplined' Budget could see it test 1.34.

stories.meaning: Your funds are priced in pounds but mostly own dollar assets, so a weaker pound after the Budget would lift their sterling value, and a stronger one would trim it.

British Pound weakens to near 1.3300 ahead of UK budget, Fed rate decision

stories.summary: The Chancellor's Budget is at about 12:30 UK today. Economists in a Reuters poll put fiscal headroom at about £10-12bn, down from £23.6bn in March; income tax, VAT and NI rates are pledged unchanged, with a higher bank surcharge among reported measures (Admirals). The pound weakened to near $1.3300 in Asian trade ahead of the Budget and the Fed (FXStreet).

topline: Big day ahead: UK Budget at 12:30, Fed decision at 6pm UK (hold expected), then Alphabet (EPS ~$3.02 expected) and Microsoft report after the US close.
OpenAI is weighing buying Google's TPU chips (The Information), a plus for Alphabet and a sign Nvidia's top customers want alternatives.
Oil rose about 1.4% (Brent ~$115) after a reported Houthi strike on Saudi Arabia's biggest refinery; gold eased to about $4,030.
Asia rallied after Wall Street: Kospi +5.6% on SK Hynix's record profit. Autodesk fell 3% Tuesday while Grab edged up from its low.
Nasdaq is about 4% below its 6 Oct high and VWRP about 2.5% below its high (27 Oct closes).
